newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld says sees 96 net at 2.4 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld says sees 96 net at 2.4 bln pesos.

text.p: Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc said on Thursday it expects to post a 2.4 billion peso net income by the end of the year.
Megaworld president Andrew Tan told reporters the amount includes extraordinary gains from the 765 million peso initial public offering (IPO) of subsidiary Empire East Land Holdings.
Tan said stripped of the IPO gains, the company will generate profits of 1.7 billion pesos by year-end.
In 1997, net recurring income is expected to reach 2.5 billion pesos, Tan added.
He said Empire East, a house builder, was expect to record profits of at least 1.4 billion this year.
As of the first nine months of the year, Megaworld said its net income rose by 237 percent at 2.086 billion pesos from 619 million pesos in the same period last year.
Megaworld has signed a joint venture agreement with Tomen Corp of Japan for the development of a 4 billion peso residential property in Manila's Quezon City district.
The agreement includes local firm Anglo-Watsons Philippines Inc as minority partner with a 20 percent stake.
Megaworld and Tomen each have a 40 percent interest in the joint venture company called Megaworld Tomen Corp.
